budget.reservation_gate: reserve exactly 424 A100-seconds before Modal spawn; clear only after remote identity, success, returned/downloaded manifest digest, and full artifact inventory validation
budget.terminal_failure_policy: retain the full 424 A100-second reservation and write an immutable terminal-failure record

measurement.request_clock: one immutable constant-cadence global plan, sharded by exact sequence parity to one bounded independent producer thread per worker
measurement.request_timestamps: record scheduled, offered, enqueued, admitted, first-token, completion, and terminal timestamps for every planned request
measurement.gpu0_only_routing: all global request IDs route to gpu0; gpu1 remains idle
measurement.two_gpu_routing: global sequence parity assigns requests round-robin to gpu0 and gpu1
measurement.queue_depth: scheduled global arrivals minus global completions at each monotonic sample
sustainable_gates: configured arrival count and empirical offer cadence/lateness/interarrival/burst behavior verified
admission timestamps monotonic and non-bursty, with maximum admission lag <= 250 ms
routing, complete request accounting, and exactly 64 output tokens for every completed request verified
bounded_probe_termination: run exactly the 1-second warmup and 10-second measurement windows
allow exactly one second of tail drain, then abort admitted unfinished requests
mark queued requests not admitted and preserve a terminal observation for every planned request
allow conclusive UNSUSTAINABLE when cadence, routing, and terminal accounting are valid but completed throughput is below offered load
treat smooth admission lag as overload evidence; treat a 500 ms admission burst pattern as methodologically inconclusive

adaptive_search.reason: prior v9 drain throughput places the likely boundary near 20 rps
obtain one clearly sustainable and one clearly unsustainable one-GPU point

adaptive_search.two_gpu_rate_rule: snap measured_one_gpu_overload_rate / 0.85 to the nearest 0.5 rps that leaves the overload at 80-90% of the two-GPU rate
adaptive_search.reason: demonstrate excess two-GPU capacity at a load already measured as a one-GPU overload

capacity_definitions.lambda_1: highest tested gpu0-only rate passing every sustainability gate
capacity_definitions.lambda_2: highest tested aggregate two-GPU rate passing every sustainability gate
capacity_definitions.lambda_spike: an actually tested gpu0-only unsustainable rate satisfying 1.15-1.30 x lambda_1 and 0.80-0.90 x lambda_2

launch_gate: v10 remains blocked until an independent reviewer accepts lambda_1, lambda_2, and lambda_spike from raw probe evidence
